title: Orders API failing with PostgreSQL connection-pool exhaustion
description: Production orders-api returns 503 and pool timeout errors. PostgreSQL reports too many clients and pg_stat_activity shows 500 active connections after a traffic increase.
business_impact: All customers are unable to place orders.

title: Read replica lag causing stale inventory availability
description: Inventory reads are more than nine minutes behind the primary. WAL replay lag is growing on the production read replica and customers see products as available after they sell out.
business_impact: Customers receive incorrect stock availability and some orders require cancellation.

title: Checkout writes blocked by database deadlocks
description: Checkout transactions are aborting with deadlock detected and lock wait timeout messages. A new order-discount transaction holds locks in a different order.
business_impact: Some customers cannot complete checkout.

title: Catalog pods in CrashLoopBackOff after config rollout
description: All new product-catalog pods are cycling in CrashLoopBackOff. Previous logs show connection refused to config-service and exit code 1 after a ConfigMap rollout.
business_impact: Product pages and search are unavailable to all customers.

title: Recommendation engine OOMKilled after larger model release
description: Recommendation pods show OOMKilled and exit code 137 every eight minutes. Memory limit is 4Gi and the new model is 2.4 times larger.
business_impact: Recommendations fall back to generic ranking for all customers.

title: Search API CPU throttling drives P99 latency above 12 seconds
description: Production search-api has 98 percent CPU, severe CPU throttling, and a growing run queue after a ranking feature launch.
business_impact: Search is slow and intermittent for most customers.

title: Elasticsearch disk pressure blocks log ingestion
description: Logging nodes crossed the disk high watermark and indices became read-only. Filebeat and Logstash queues are growing and application logs are not searchable.
business_impact: Responders cannot search the last four hours of production logs.

title: Intermittent CoreDNS resolution failures across microservices
description: Services report no such host and DNS lookup timeout errors. CoreDNS CPU throttling began after the cluster scaled from 20 to 60 nodes.
business_impact: Intermittent service-to-service failures affect multiple customer workflows.

title: Istio mTLS handshakes failing after intermediate certificate expiry
description: Eight production services report x509 certificate expired and TLS handshake failures. The cert-manager renewal order failed silently.
business_impact: All traffic between eight critical services is blocked.

title: Authentication service returns 503 for login requests
description: The external load balancer reports no healthy upstream auth targets while internal health endpoints still return 200. Login failures affect web and mobile clients.
business_impact: All customers are unable to sign in.

title: JWT signature verification failures after signing-key rotation
description: The API returns 401 unauthorized and signature verification failed. JWKS cache still contains the retired key identifier after key rotation.
business_impact: Authenticated API clients cannot access protected endpoints.

title: Payment gateway timeouts causing checkout failures
description: Payment authorization requests time out after 15 seconds and provider latency has increased. Retried transactions use idempotency keys but reconciliation is pending.
business_impact: A large portion of customers cannot complete payment.

title: Stripe webhook backlog delays payment confirmation
description: Webhook endpoints return 504 and 14000 provider callbacks are queued. The Lambda event source mapping is disabled and oldest event age is 45 minutes.
business_impact: Successful payments remain unconfirmed and orders are delayed.

title: Notification queue backlog delays customer messages
description: SQS queue depth is 280000 and oldest message age is three hours. Consumer concurrency was reduced from 500 to 50.
business_impact: Order confirmations and shipping alerts are delayed.

title: Redis session cache outage causes login failures
description: Redis connections are refused and session cache nodes have no healthy replica. Authentication requests generate a cache miss storm against the database.
business_impact: Existing sessions fail and login traffic is overloading the database.

title: WAF rate-limit rule blocks enterprise customer traffic
description: A new rate limit misconfiguration returns 429 responses to legitimate enterprise traffic behind shared NAT addresses. Twelve customer accounts escalated.
business_impact: Enterprise customers are blocked and revenue is at risk.

title: Load balancer reports no healthy upstream for checkout
description: External users receive 502 bad gateway. The target group marks every checkout backend unhealthy after the health-check path changed.
business_impact: All customers are unable to reach checkout.

title: Profile API error spike immediately after release 8.2.0
description: HTTP 5xx increased from 0.2 to 18 percent immediately after deployment of release 8.2.0. The prior version is rollback compatible.
business_impact: Customers intermittently cannot load or update profiles.

title: Billing worker fails after invalid database secret rotation
description: New pods fail startup with secret missing and invalid password errors. Existing pods continue working with the previous secret version.
business_impact: New billing jobs are not processing and the queue is growing.

title: Address verification vendor API unavailable
description: The external provider status page reports a third party outage. Vendor API requests time out in all regions while internal service health remains normal.
business_impact: New customer onboarding is delayed but manual review remains available.
